description: This file defines a delegator system for wrapping and extending the http.ResponseWriter interface in Go, supporting various HTTP features like flushing, hijacking, pushing, and notification, with dynamic delegation based on capabilities.

classes.name: responseWriterDelegator
classes.description: A struct that wraps http.ResponseWriter and tracks response status, bytes written, and header state, with a callback for observing header writes.

classes.name: closeNotifierDelegator
classes.description: A struct embedding responseWriterDelegator that implements the CloseNotify method.

classes.name: flusherDelegator
classes.description: A struct embedding responseWriterDelegator that implements the Flush method.

classes.name: hijackerDelegator
classes.description: A struct embedding responseWriterDelegator that implements the Hijack method.

classes.name: readerFromDelegator
classes.description: A struct embedding responseWriterDelegator that implements the ReadFrom method.

classes.name: pusherDelegator
classes.description: A struct embedding responseWriterDelegator that implements the Push method.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the response.

methods.name: Written
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes written to the response.

methods.name: WriteHeader
methods.description: Sets the HTTP status code and calls observeWriteHeader if set.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes bytes to the response, calling WriteHeader if not already called.

methods.name: CloseNotify
methods.description: Returns a channel that receives a notification when the client connection has gone away (deprecated in newer Go versions).

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes buffered data to the client.

methods.name: Hijack
methods.description: Hijacks the connection, allowing for low-level control.

methods.name: ReadFrom
methods.description: Reads data from an io.Reader and writes it to the response.

methods.name: Push
methods.description: Pushes a resource to the client using HTTP/2 server push.

methods.name: newDelegator
methods.description: Creates a delegator wrapping the given ResponseWriter, selecting capabilities based on supported interfaces.
